About Brillio:

Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers and a partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Brillio, renowned for its world-class professionals, referred to as "Brillians", distinguishes itself through their capacity to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge digital and design thinking skills with an unwavering dedication to client satisfaction.

Brillio takes pride in its status as an employer of choice, consistently attracting the most exceptional and talented individuals due to its unwavering emphasis on contemporary, groundbreaking technologies, and exclusive digital projects. Brillio's relentless commitment to providing an exceptional experience to its Brillians and nurturing their full potential consistently garners them the Great Place to Work® certification year after year.

Full Stack Developer (Java and React)

Primary Skills
• Java, React

Job requirements

Role: Full Stack Developer/Lead (Java and React)

Years of Experience: 10+ years

Location: OnSite - Boston, MA

As a consultant within the Vertical team, you will work with our clients to define their digital strategy and execution roadmap, and design and implement differentiated digital solutions to help deliver measurable value.

Job Description:
• Highly versatile and experienced full-stack developer with deep expertise across both backend and frontend technologies.
• Expert-level proficiency in Core Java, including advanced concepts such as multithreading and concurrency, as well as strong experience working with Oracle databases, specifically SQL and PL/SQL.On the backend, the candidate must have a solid understanding of messaging and integration patterns, including hands-on experience with JMS-based messaging protocols; familiarity with Sonic MQ is strongly preferred.
• Experience working with WebSocket protocols is essential to support real-time communication requirements within the platform.On the frontend, must demonstrate expert-level capability in React UI development, along with strong command of HTML5 and the broader React ecosystem. The role is heavily focused on modernizing the user interface and will involve the migration of a complex Sell-Side thick-client Swing UI to a Web-based LINK platform. This work is critical to the success of the Sell-Side Web strategy, and any loss of expertise in this area would significantly impact ongoing and future delivery.
• Above entry-level, working knowledge of Python, as there will be occasional involvement in FX Connect (FXC) Data Hub development and related initiatives.
• Rapidly understand a highly complex full-stack technology landscape
• Operate with minimal supervision and seamlessly align design and development decisions with the existing system architecture and overall platform strategy.
• Work within established frameworks and architectural patterns, contributing high-quality, scalable enhancements at speed.

Why should you apply for this role?

As Brillio continues to gain momentum as a trusted partner for our clients in their digital transformation journey, we strive to set new benchmarks for speed and value creation. The DI team at Brillio is at the forefront of leading this charge by reimagining and executing how we structure, sell and deliver our services to better serve our clients.
